author: GamingBolt
description:
We're the first to admit we never fully moved on from the Titanfall franchise. We still look back at Titanfall 2 and all the memories we built with Cooper and BT as they tried to take on the IMC while learning more about each other in a story that made things pretty bleak for their budding bromance. 

That one always has a special place in our hearts, and we probably won't stop pining for a sequel as we have done for a decade. But Shatter Rush might just be the copium we need to get over years of wishful thinking. It's too early to tell, but the version that currently exists has a lot of potential to be a mech-shooter that captures exactly what made Titanfall appealing back in the day. Curious? Good! Join us as we take you through what’s working and what needs more work in this upcoming shooter.
title: Is This the Closest Thing We’ll Ever Get to Titanfall 3?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Hernand has become the talk of Pywel and beyond in the two weeks since Crimson Desert's launch. It's always awesome when a game gets so popular there are memes about it, but it's quite surprising to see so many of those memes talk about spending an inordinate amount of time in what would be considered its opening area by any modern standard.

What's so good about Hernand that keeps its players from going beyond its borders to lands that are equally compelling? We're here to tell you all about that. Hop on your horse and join us as we take you on a journey through a land filled with intrigue and excitement.
title: Crimson Desert's Hernand Alone Feels Like A Full Open-World Game
